data.name: Rrahul
data.gender_notes: Rrahul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rrahul is a combination of the prefix 'Ra-', which is derived from the name Rama, meaning 'gem', and the suffix '-hul', which is a variant of the name Hari, meaning 'thief of hearts'. Thus, Rrahul means 'Gem of Rama, or the one who steals the hearts of people like Rama did.'. The name Rrahul carries the meaning “Gem of Rama” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rrahul usually hope their child will grow to embody gem of rama and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rrahul is a name that signifies the inner power and intelligence that one possesses. It is a name that embodies the qualities of the sun, such as warmth, vitality, and energy, and represents the fire within each individual. It is a name that is deeply spiritual and symbolizes the connection between the divine and the human.
data.etymology: Rrahul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gem of Rama.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rrahul total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
